Add an opt-in BMad workflow for preparing, validating, and contributing a large change as a sequence

## Summary

`src/scripts/memlog.py` makes each individual replacement atomic, but the
complete read → modify → replace cycle in `cmd_append`, `cmd_set`, and
`cmd_init` has no inter-process lock. Concurrent writers can read the same base

writers can also fail with `PermissionError` while sharing the fixed `.tmp`
path.

This matters when parallel agents or headless jobs journal to the same
`.memlog.md`.

Run 50 concurrent `append` processes against one memlog on current `main`
